media_item.summary_notes: The Darlie Routier case has received significant media coverage. Key points of contention include the interpretation of forensic evidence like blood spatter, the plausibility of the intruder story versus staging, and the debated financial motive. Ongoing DNA testing highlights the persistent questions surrounding the case.

featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Capital Murder (of son Damon; also charged re: son Devon)
featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Convicted in 1997 for the capital murder of her son Damon and charged in the death of her son Devon, Darlie Routier remains on death row. The case hinges on the interpretation of blood spatter evidence, the plausibility of the intruder story, and an alleged financial motive. Appeals have been denied, but DNA testing has been ordered multiple times since 2018, with results still pending.
